scope: BRE-453 November application rework; preparatory design while BRE-448/449/450/451 await merge gates

1.summary: Readable mail, direct importance correction, calm retrieval and dependable correspondence; responsive web and native iOS; privacy and account boundaries preserved.

2.summary: Proposed compact Mail/Drafts hierarchy; 16 surface families and 10 state families inventoried; preserve deep links and user-owned organization; primary filter remains open.

3.summary: Five proposed journeys cover triage/correction, durable writing, safe saved views, important-only interruption and account/search recovery, including stale/failure exits.
